def gridmap(fr):

        r0 = min(p[0] for p in b); r1 = max(p[0] for p in b)
        c0 = min(p[1] for p in b); c1 = max(p[1] for p in b)
        if n['color'] in ('W','Y','B'): continue
        # assign to cell by center
        cr = (r0+r1)//2; cc = (c0+c1)//2

        cj = next((j for j,x in enumerate(cols_cells) if x-1<=cc<=x+10), None)
        out.setdefault((ci,cj),[]).append((n['color'], n['pixels'], (r0,c0,r1,c1), n['shape_hash']))
    return out

def solve4(givens, boxes=True, diags=True):
    # givens: dict (i,j)->v ; backtracking search
    from itertools import product
    g = dict(givens)
    blanks = [(i,j) for i in range(4) for j in range(4) if (i,j) not in g or g[(i,j)] in (0,None)]
    def ok(g,i,j,v):
        for k in range(4):
            if g.get((i,k))==v and k!=j: return False
            if g.get((k,j))==v and k!=i: return False
        if boxes:
            r0,c0 = 2*(i//2), 2*(j//2)
            for r in range(r0,r0+2):
                for c in range(c0,c0+2):
                    if (r,c)!=(i,j) and g.get((r,c))==v: return False
        if diags:
            if i==j:
                for k in range(4):
                    if (k,k)!=(i,j) and g.get((k,k))==v: return False
            if i+j==3:
                for k in range(4):
                    if (k,3-k)!=(i,j) and g.get((k,3-k))==v: return False
        return True
    sols=[]
    def rec(g, idx):
        if len(sols)>3: return
        if idx==len(blanks):
            sols.append(dict(g)); return
        i,j = blanks[idx]
        for v in (1,2,3,4):
            if ok(g,i,j,v):
                g[(i,j)]=v; rec(g,idx+1); del g[(i,j)]
    rec(g,0)
    return sols
